summary: A choice-only coefficient pattern solves three generator profiles, including two of the five delivered batch questions. Two rated source profiles are also missing. Arithmetic, grading, scope, rendering and runtime packaging checks passed.

source_analysis.skill: Infer two missing additive elementary column operations that zero the nonpivot entries of one row in a 4x4 matrix.
reasoning_steps: Identify the unchanged source column and row reduced to zeros in B.
For each missing target column solve a_ri + k a_rp = 0; confirm A[:,i]+k A[:,p]=B[:,i].
Select the pair of operations from five choices; follow three sequential matrices in the explanation.
invariants: Source column remains unchanged and nonzero.
Three other columns each receive a multiple of the same source column.
Exactly two operations missing and one given; additive operations only.
Every displayed intermediate and final matrix follows the stated operations.
permitted_variations: All four pivot rows and columns, which of the three operations is supplied, signs and magnitudes of integer multipliers, nonpivot entries, and distractor order.
Pivot signs and small nonunit pivots are supported; preserve integer arithmetic and comparable size.
The signs, equality of the missing multipliers, and correct option position are incidental assignments, not fixed instructional constraints.

source_replay.details: Ten rated source banks and canonical backbone replay correctly, including the justified q-91210 sign correction. Rated q-130617 and q-130630 are absent. Unrated q-91208 is explicitly excluded from sampling; its full bank was independently verified.

math.details: Parsed displayed matrices and operations independently using exact rational arithmetic. Verified all 120 fresh samples, all five batch records, controlled pairs, supported source replays and 48 explicit role combinations, including every intermediate matrix and all answer choices.

variety.details: Rows, pivot columns, supplied operations and multiplier signs vary, but the package omits two current moderate source bank profiles. The separate decision check also demonstrates a persistent incidental bank cue.

scope.details: Sampled output retains 4x4 integer matrices, three additive column operations, one given/two missing operations, and one five-choice radio response. No new operators or reasoning stages observed.

grading.details: Actual native learner grader: 129 accepted and 516 rejected choices, zero unresolved. All five choices tested per record. Controlled relevant changes reject the old pair; irrelevant changes preserve the correct mathematical pair. Free-entry equivalence is inapplicable to this radio contract.

rendering.details: Six actual-UI previews passed and representative screenshots were inspected. Wide display math uses working horizontal scrolling; middle/end solution stages were verified. Desktop rendering only.

packaging.details: Installed Python 3.13.5 and SymPy 1.14.0 exactly match the manifest. Deterministic replay, relocated import and CLI, declared-file existence, unsupported-difficulty rejection and zero-pivot rejection verified. Repair history and preflight files are absent.

decision_variation.details: The visible four-plus-one coefficient pattern predicts 36/36 applicable fresh answers and 2/2 applicable batch answers without matrices. All 120 fresh and five batch records survive actual delivery filtering. UI permutation does not remove the cue. Selection analysis uses actual rules with explicit history/weight limits. Captured inventory basis 5579 contains only 13 original sources and no generated historical records.

findings.description: In q-130619, q-130627 and q-130624, four choices have the same ordered absolute multiplier pair and the fifth swaps those magnitudes. If that singleton is (u,v), choosing (-v,-u) always identifies the correct pair. This uses only the answer bank. It succeeds on 36/36 independent samples and both applicable delivered batch records.
